system.description:
Flow Broken is treated as a Physical Condition. Creatures with it have had their combat flow broken. They have functionally stopped in their tracks as they recover. They suffer the following effects.

Disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws.

An affected creature cannot cast jutsu that share keywords with jutsu they've cast since the beginning of their last turn.

The affected creature's initiative count is reduced by 4. If this would cause them to shift position in initiative, they move positions at the beginning of the next round.

This condition ends at the end of an affected creature's turn.
system.summary: Disadvantage on Dexterity saves; can't cast jutsu sharing a keyword with one it cast since its last turn began; initiative −4 (the order changes at the start of the next round).
